<!doctype html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>رحلة الطائف | القيادة الليلية</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--gold:#e9c68f;--dim:#c5b6a0;--panel:#151310}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#161513;font:14px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff3dd;overflow:hidden}
canvas{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;inset:0}
button,select,input::file-selector-button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:#26211b;border:1px solid #726046;border-radius:8px;padding:.55em .75em;cursor:pointer}button:hover,button:focus-visible{background:#503a24}button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
[hidden]{display:none!important}.overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:clamp(20px,6vw,100px);background:linear-gradient(270deg,#15110eea,transparent 80%)}
.intro{max-width:440px;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #000}.intro h1{font-size:clamp(42px,7vw,100px);line-height:1;margin:.2em 0}.intro p{font-size:18px;color:#efe0c6;line-height:1.7}.primary{background:#e9c68f;color:#21160e;font-weight:800;padding:.85em 1.7em}.primary:hover{background:#ffdb9c}
.top{position:absolute;inset:14px 14px auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:8px;pointer-events:none}.top>*{pointer-events:auto}.badge,.notice,.pedals button{background:#191611e8;border:1px solid #826d4a;border-radius:10px;padding:.55em .8em}.badge b{color:var(--gold)}.notice{position:absolute;top:24%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;max-width:90%;width:max-content}
.dash{position:absolute;bottom:6%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(58vw,680px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.4fr;gap:4px;padding:6px;direction:ltr;background:#131312;border:1px solid #756754;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px #0009}
.screen{direction:rtl;min-width:0;border:1px solid #37342b;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#282821,#111414);padding:clamp(6px,1vw,14px)}.speed{text-align:center;display:grid;place-content:center}.speed strong{font-size:clamp(27px,5vw,72px);line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.speed small{color:var(--gold)}.fuel{margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim)}
.route{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--gold);gap:6px;font-size:12px}.route svg{width:55px;height:24px}.distances{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim)}.media{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:4px;border-top:1px solid #55503f;margin-top:5px;padding-top:5px;font-size:11px}.media button{padding:4px 6px}.media input[type=range]{width:58px;accent-color:var(--gold)}.track{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:120px;white-space:nowrap}
.pedals{position:absolute;bottom:12px;inset-inline:10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none}.pedals div{display:flex;gap:4px}.pedals button{touch-action:none;pointer-events:auto;min-height:36px}.pedals button.active{background:#a57c49;color:#15120d}.rush{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:inset 0 0 75px #ffae4677}.rush::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 7deg at 50% 45%,transparent 0 17deg,#fff5 18deg,transparent 19deg 30deg);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse,transparent 48%,black);animation:pulse .18s infinite alternate}@keyframes pulse{to{opacity:.2}}
dialog{background:#211b15;color:inherit;border:1px solid #877153;border-radius:14px;padding:20px;max-width:min(92vw,440px)}dialog::backdrop{background:#0009}dialog label{display:block;margin:10px 0}dialog input{max-width:100%}
@media(max-width:670px){.dash{bottom:55px;width:94vw}.top{inset:7px 8px auto}.badge{font-size:11px}.distances{font-size:10px}.overlay{align-items:end;padding-bottom:12vh}.notice{top:20%}.pedals button{padding:.5em .65em}}
@media(min-width:800px){.dash{left:69.4%;width:min(50vw,730px);bottom:9.2%;padding:3px;border-radius:10px}.intro{max-width:480px}.intro h1{font-size:clamp(42px,5.5vw,85px);white-space:nowrap}}
.dash{background:#0d0e10;border-color:#615547;box-shadow:0 2px 2px #000,0 14px 28px #0007}.screen{background:linear-gradient(158deg,#292b2d,#121416 49%,#101215);border-color:#323231}.speed strong{font-weight:500}.screen small{letter-spacing:.05em}.top .badge{background:#17191ad0;border-color:#fff3}.intro p{max-width:390px}
#view{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 46% 43%,#9e735649,transparent 57%),linear-gradient(#10121b,#1e202b 32%,#514047 55%,#16151a)}
#intro{background:linear-gradient(270deg,#140e13f0 0%,#130d15b0 25%,transparent 74%),url("data:image/jpeg;base64,
